primitives.name: cMATRA mint policy
primitives.desc: One-shot parameterized mint policy for the 1B cMATRA supply, with an invariant rejecting datum-less script outputs.

primitives.name: cMATRA claim validator
primitives.desc: Dual-admin surrender pool: seven legacy assets in at TWAP-locked rates, cMATRA out, with a fixed redemption deadline.

primitives.name: cMATRA quarantine validator
primitives.desc: Quarantine script for surrendered legacy assets.

primitives.name: Surrender API
primitives.desc: Wallet-driven surrender flow: CIP-30 partial-sign, a co-signer that signs only after the claimant has and whose witness the primary verifies before it signs, re-verifying every transaction against a strict surrender policy (golden-tested on every mainnet surrender), its own chain view (every input unspent on chain, no unit above its pinned supply, no pinned NFT minted or burned since the pin) and a per-signer ledger that refuses approvals that can never land and holds each legacy unit to its pinned remaining supply and the pool to a 24-hour cap, pool-tip tracking and UTxO defrag tooling.
